To determine how old you need to be to purchase alcohol, we must consider that alcohol purchase age laws vary significantly around the world. 
- In the United States, the legal age is 21.
- In the United Kingdom and many European countries, it is 18 (or sometimes 16 for certain beverages).
- In some other parts of the world, it might be different or there may be no legal drinking age at all.

Because the required age changes entirely depending on the jurisdiction or country you are located in, no single static age applies globally.
